fixSummary: The edge adapter now treats any GET request carrying error=state_mismatch as an OAuth recovery request unless it targets Cloudflare/Next static internals.
The edge adapter now rewrites downstream 3xx redirects whose Location contains error=state_mismatch into the clean OAuth reset login URL.
The main Worker source middleware now has the same app-level fallback for future full Worker deploys so marketing pages cannot cache or render state_mismatch query responses.
